subject.title: [Bug]: WHAM probe with expired access token puts refreshable OpenAI profile into false 12h cooldown

question: Should maintainers accept the linked policy change that skips WHAM probing when the OpenAI OAuth access token is locally expired?
rationale: The change controls OAuth token-health classification, profile cooldown state, and provider fallback behavior, and the issue carries protected maintainer/security routing.

options.title: Review and land the linked fix
options.body: Accept the narrow expiry-aware WHAM probe guard with regression and real-behavior proof, while preserving valid-token 401 cooldown behavior.

options.title: Request broader auth policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a wider provider-health policy across WHAM, refresh, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Reject the change
options.body: Keep the current cooldown behavior for expired stored tokens and document the false-outage tradeoff as intentional.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked fix
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow expiry-aware WHAM probe guard with regression and real-behavior proof, while preserving valid-token 401 cooldown behavior.
